title: trending-local-llms measurements contract
description: JSON Schema that data/measurements.json must conform to. Keyed by model_id -> array of per-engine t/s measurement rows. Each row carries the footprint of THE RUN that produced the figure and a reference to the source post; engagement counters do NOT live here (they are published once in data/posts.json, issue #689). Enforced by scripts/validate.py.

engine.description: Inference engine that produced the t/s figure.

source_post.description: The X post (lightbrd mirror) that reported this figure; its engagement is resolved from posts.json.

weight_gb.description: OPTIONAL. Weight footprint of the QUANT THIS MEASUREMENT RAN IN, as the post states it.

context_tokens.description: OPTIONAL. Context window this measurement ran with, as the post states it.

system_ram_min.description: OPTIONAL. System RAM / unified memory this measurement needed, as the post states it.

storage_offload.description: OPTIONAL. Storage-offload this measurement needed, as the post states it.

engine_min_version.description: OPTIONAL. Engine minimum build / required flags THIS measurement needed.

items.description: Engagement counters are intentionally ABSENT from the row: they live in posts.json under source_post. Footprint keys are declared; a genuinely new measurement dimension must be added to this contract in the same change (additive-only, AGENTS §2.3b).
